user_query: I need an object detection model to locate people, dogs, and cats in indoor and outdoor photographs. The objects may appear at different scales, under varied lighting, and may be partially occluded by furniture or other people. The model will run locally on a MacBook Air with an Apple M4 chip and 16 GB of unified memory, using Metal acceleration where supported. It should aim for a mAP@0.5:0.95 of approximately 0.40 or higher and recall of at least 0.75 for each class. Processing an image within roughly 500 milliseconds would be desirable.
use_case_description: Locate persons, dogs, and cats in indoor and outdoor photographs; objects may appear at different scales, under varied lighting, and may be occluded by furniture or other people.

available_hardware.details: Apple Silicon MacBook Air with M4, Metal acceleration
